rationale.anksi: User adopted 忧ᴬᴷ. PIV explicitly relates anksio and angoro as degrees of the same state; 忧 already conveys anxious concern. Reuse the existing 忧, preserve the medical annotation and decomposition, reduce the kanji body from 17 to 7 strokes. angor retains unmarked 忧.
